_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Benzene (2): isothermal total pressures at 313.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.
